title: From C to Idiomatic Rust: A Ship-of-Theseus Agentic Translation
abstract: arXiv:2607.28835v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: C underpins operating systems, embedded platforms, and network infrastructure as its abstractions map directly to machine behaviour. Its explicit memory model, predictable data representations, and minimal runtime allow compilers to generate fast, deterministic code. These properties also leave correctness and memory safety entirely to the programmer, making undefined behaviour, pointer misuse, and lifetime errors persistent sources of defects and security vulnerabilities in long-lived C codebases. Rust eliminates most failure modes through a static ownership and borrowing model that enforces memory safety and aliasing constraints at compile time. However, mature C systems cannot be translated directly: implicit layout assumptions, aliasing patterns, and undefined behaviour must be reconstructed before safe Rust can be produced. translated_title: 从C到地道Rust：忒修斯之船式的智能体翻译
translated_abstract: C语言是操作系统、嵌入式平台和网络基础设施的基石，因为其抽象可直接映射到机器行为。其显式的内存模型、可预测的数据表示和极简的运行时使编译器能够生成快速且确定性的代码。然而，这些特性也将正确性和内存安全完全交由程序员负责，使得未定义行为、指针误用和生命周期错误成为长期维护的C代码库中缺陷与安全漏洞的持续来源。Rust通过静态所有权和借用模型在编译时强制执行内存安全和别名约束，从而消除了大多数故障模式。然而，成熟的C系统无法被直接翻译：必须先重建隐式的内存布局假设、别名模式以及未定义行为，才能生成安全的Rust代码。本文提出了一种迁移方法，首先生成语义保持的、非地道的Rust（注：原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种“忒修斯之船”式的智能体翻译方法：先将C代码转换为语义保持但非地道的Rust代码，再逐步将其重构为符合Rust习惯用法的地道代码，从而安全地将成熟C系统迁移至内存安全的Rust。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Ship-of-Theseus agentic translation methodology that migrates mature C systems to Rust by first generating semantics-preserving, non-idiomatic Rust and then incrementally refactoring it into idiomatic, memory-safe code.
